description: One approved canonical YouTube full trailer per non-sequel show (short-form included). Use youtubeStatus 'not_found' only after checking YouTube for a substantive full trailer, 'unavailable' when a previously approved video disappears. Other-site links can be saved locally by any visitor when no YouTube trailer is selected; not a public submission.

entryExample.note: Documentation only. A per-show candidates array may contain other approved full trailers. Playlist sync must use only canonical youtubeId.

youtubeStatusReference.unavailable: Formerly approved trailer no longer accessible
youtubeStatusReference.note: Do not mark unreviewed shows as missing.
